national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves Key Schemes for Fast-Track Courts, Energy Storage, Statistical Reforms, and Critical Minerals
bullets: The Union Cabinet approved the continuation of the Centrally Sponsored Scheme for Fast Track Special Courts (exclusive POCSO courts) for five years starting April 1, 2026, with a total outlay of Rs 3,788.04 crore (Central share of Rs 2,353.15 crore funded via the Nirbhaya Fund).

Approved a Rs 14,500 crore Viability Gap Funding (VGF) Scheme to build 92 GWh grid-scale energy storage capacity by 2030–31 (60 GWh pumped hydro, 30 GWh battery storage, and 2 GWh emerging technologies), requiring a minimum 40% domestic content for battery projects.

Sanctioned the Viksit Bharat Initiative for Statistical Transformation, Analytics & Research (VISTAR) for modernizing national statistics using AI, alongside a new capital subsidy scheme to boost domestic processing of critical minerals like lithium, nickel, and cobalt.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government to Roll Out AI-Powered e-Cabinet System
bullets: Bihar state government is preparing to launch an e-Cabinet system to transition cabinet decision-making into a 100% paperless, digital workflow.
The platform will integrate Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to simplify complex administrative procedures and accelerate departmental approvals.
The initiative builds upon previous digital governance measures, including the UPYOG portal connecting 264 urban local bodies across the state.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Launches Free Sugarcane Seed Scheme to Revive Closed Sugar Mills
bullets: The Bihar Sugarcane Department has launched a free seed distribution drive to boost sugarcane production around the Raiyam (Darbhanga) and Sakri (Madhubani) sugar mills, which have been closed for over three decades.
Farmers owning between 0.25 acre and 2.5 acres of land are eligible to apply online through the official portal (ccs.bihar.gov.in).
The program provides free improved seed varieties, financial assistance, and modern cultivation training to secure raw material supply prior to restarting the mills.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Launches Two Portals for Diaspora Engagement and Investment
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister launched the 'Bihar Foundation Portal' and the 'Bihar Business Connect-2027 Portal' to connect the state's global diaspora and streamline investor registrations.
The Bihar Foundation currently manages 55 active chapters (31 international and 24 national), with targets to expand to 100 chapters by the end of the next financial year.
The state government also announced plans to establish 10 integrated centers across India to promote trade, investment, and tourism.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Targets 24 GW Renewable Energy Capacity by 2030
bullets: Bihar pitched investment opportunities worth ₹2.57 lakh crore in its power sector at the India Renewable Energy Summit and Expo 2026 in New Delhi.
Under the Bihar Renewable Energy Policy 2025, the state aims to achieve 24 GW of renewable energy capacity and 6 GWh of energy storage capacity by 2030.
Key initiatives highlighted include the 301 MW Kajra Solar Power Project featuring a 523 MWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), alongside three signed MoUs for sector skill training and research.

bihar_news.title: Patna-Purnia Expressway (NE-9) Proposed as Bihar's First Greenfield National Expressway
bullets: The proposed 6-lane Patna-Purnia Expressway, designated as National Expressway-9 (NE-9), is set to become Bihar's first national expressway corridor.
The greenfield route will originate at Mirnagar in Vaishali district and terminate at Chand Bhatti in Purnia district, passing through Samastipur, Darbhanga, Saharsa, and Madhepura.
Additional proposed infrastructure projects for the state include a Central University near Vikramshila and the Ajgaibinath Greenfield Airport near Sultanganj in Bhagalpur district.
